_readme: First read of Los Angeles Valley College's program maps (S345, SkyLantern). The registry records a ppm sequence source at www.lavc.edu/academics/pathways/program-mapper and no access reading. A web search (2026-10-08) found the page and LAVC's pathways page, which say each map shows 'a semester-by-semester path' with the recommended courses for a full-time student. This read loads the college's page and prints the mapper host it links; that host is read in a later plan once named, one load, since every Program Mapper host read so far answered 403 (lesson 33).

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map: its own pages, a PDF, or only its Program Mapper.
questions.mapper_open: Whether the college's Program Mapper host answers the reader (one load), and how it lists programs and terms if it does.
